title: feat(plugin-webhooks)!: declared webhooks are held per namespace, each holder dispatched and switched as its own (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 2/3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgV1Wp8HYsu2keXwrYrCpGHZ)_

epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZu9RRx2o8sFUUpEPU

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自声明同名 webhook，每个包的声明按（包，名）各自订阅、各自开关、各自投递；包的声明产生的投递 `ref_id` 改为 `declared:PKG/NAME`（环境自己的声明仍是 `declared:NAME`）；新增限定启用门 `POST /security/_activation/webhook/:ns/:name`；两个持有者时，裸读 `/meta/webhook/NAME`、`/published` 和裸启用门都答 409 并列出两者（启用门原来答 503）。第 2 轮：被禁用的包不算服务中的持有者（不派发、不可重投递，但账本归属仍按全部持有者算）；`ref_id` 上限 128 → 384，`dedup_key` 超过 191 时用 sha256 摘要，原来能投递的名字仍能投递；升级影响报告按（包，名）读。第 3 轮：不带包的旧投递（`declared:NAME`）重投递时按全部持有者计数，停用包也算，两个及以上即拒并逐个点名；changeset 与正文的几处说法按实测改正。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的 webhook 部分（#31699 三个 PR 中的第 2 个）。第 0 步实测：只翻三个集合而不改读取方，另一命名空间装进同名 webhook 后，两个持有者都会悄悄停发。所以先把派发器、开关账本、启用门、重投递守卫、名字守卫都改为按（包，名）读，再翻集合。
- 风险与回滚：收窄四处，已声明，工作区内受影响的调用方为 0（第三处随合入 main 的 #32351 而来：两个包经 `DatabaseLoader` 保存的同名 webhook，不点名包读历史、比较、回滚改为 409 列出两者；第四处随合入 main 的 #32497 而来：只有停用包持有的 webhook 名，`MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` 与 `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` 由停用包的声明改为 `undefined`，`exists` 由 true 改为 false）：两个持有者的裸 `/meta/webhook/NAME`（及其 `/published`）由先注册者改为 409；按 `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` 选投递行的消费方，升级后的新行要改为匹配 `declared:PKG/NAME`。`ref_id` 加宽在已有的 PostgreSQL/MySQL 库上要 `os migrate apply`（`safe` 的 `widen_varchar`），执行前，包 id 加名字超过 118 字符的单持有者 webhook 会在插入时被拒（裁定 Q2 已接受，changeset 写明）。滚动升级期间，旧节点重投递新形状的行会 fail closed（拒绝，不会发错持有者）；跨升级同一 webhook 的投递之间不保证顺序。只有一个持有者且其包已启用时，除新投递的 `ref_id` 外，所有答案不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts`（`packageScopedRegistryOf` 的 served / every、`slotsOf`、`webhookSlotSwitch`、`DeclaredWebhookSource`），`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`（`resolveQualifiedWebhook`），`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-guard.ts`（`judgeDeclared`，第 3 轮）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run src/declared-webhooks.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts`，应全绿；"one declaration per (package, name) slot"（含 "a disabled co-holder"）和 "a declared webhook two packages declare" 两节逐条钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；第 2 轮的四个开放问题已由裁定 R3 定（见文末）。

Part of #31699

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — four answers move for a caller that worked before. (1) The bare `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` of a name two packages hold (a disabled package holds none here, #32497), and its published read `GET /meta/webhook/NAME/published` (which asks the bare item read for the item's package), are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where they served the first registered package's declaration; before this change that state existed only for a clash the cold boot sealed with a warning. (2) A declared webhook a package ships is subscribed, and its new deliveries are written, under `ref_id = declared:PKG/NAME`, where they carried `declared:NAME`; a consumer that selects deliveries by `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` no longer matches the ones written after the upgrade. (3) The history, diff and rollback of a webhook name two packages saved through `DatabaseLoader` (`MetadataManager.getHistory` / `diff` / `rollback`), naming no package, are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where they answered every version of the one row both saves wrote, and a rollback to the version of a package removed since is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming it), where it wrote that body into the remaining holder's row: #32351's rules reach `webhook` with `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`. (4) For a webhook name only disabled packages hold, `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` and `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` (`@objectstack/objectql`) answer `undefined` where they answered the disabled package's declaration, and `MetadataFacade.exists` answers false where it answered true: #32497's rule for the package-scoped readers reaches `webhook` with `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, and the by-name door already answered `404`. Widened beside them: the engine's package door, item seam and cold-boot seal admit a second package holder of a webhook name that declares another namespace, and the dispatcher, which subscribed neither holder of such a name, subscribes each one; the bare `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` of a name one enabled and one disabled package hold, where the disabled one registered first, answers the enabled holder's declaration (`200`) where it answered `404`; and the unscoped plural reads (`MemoryLoader` and `MetadataManager` `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed`) of a webhook name two packages saved answer both, where they answered the one saved last.
Metadata-protocol: added (a second package's webhook declaration of a name another namespace holds is now accepted, where it was refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`; no key, value or requirement an author writes against is refused or tightened)
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0 is updated in this PR (the `ref_id` shape and the namespace door beside the bare one; seat-approved addition, 04:03Z), and §4.3's `dedup_key` sentence (ruling R3, Q4); no published skill teaches a declared webhook's name scope, its `ref_id` or the activation door (`grep -rn "declared:\|_activation/webhook\|sys_http_delivery\|ref_id" skills/`: one hit, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:79`, a comment about published keys, unrelated).

**Narrowing: yes**, first-party callers **0** (measured). (1) No first-party package pair holds one webhook name across two packages; the full dogfood battery, which boots the showcase, CRM and every example app, is green with the refusal on. (2) No in-tree consumer selects `sys_http_delivery` by a literal `declared:NAME`: the four dogfood suites that read a delivery's `ref_id` are moved to the new shape in this PR (`upgrade-18x-harness`, `webhook-materialization`, `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide`, `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`), and the CLI's 18.x ownership ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME` (seat ruling Q4), which the redelivery guard still reads. (3) No first-party caller reads `MetadataManager` history: the REST `/meta/:type/:name/history`, `/rollback` and `/diff` doors go through the protocol's own repository (`rest-route-ledger.ts:277`, as #32351 states), and a grep of non-test sources finds no caller of `MetadataManager.getHistory` / `rollback` / `diff` outside `metadata-manager.ts`. (4) `MetadataFacade` is never constructed in-tree, and the one non-test caller of `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` outside the facade, the protocol's by-name read (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:577`), already answered `404` for that name (grep, as #32497's changeset states for the other types).

This is the second of three PRs for #31699: email_template (#32214, merged), webhook here, then connector. Only `webhook` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here (the flow joined it with #31696, merged).

## Seat rulings this PR implements

Comment [6813532941](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6813532941):

- **Q1 = A.** A ledger row naming no package, for a name two packages hold, is no holder's own (ADR-0150 D4). Switched off, it keeps every holder with no row of its own off. Switched on, it turns none on. The reader says so once per name, naming both. This is the flow engine's rule from #31696.
- **Q2.** All three type sets flip, the metadata slotted store included.
- **Q3.** The file surface below.
- **Q4.** The CLI 18.x ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME`, pinned.
- **Q5.** Branch `claude/project-thread-3giljf`, a new draft PR, `Part of #31699`.

Round 2, comment [6816940784](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6816940784) (after CR 6816920433 and red-line 6816929999):

- **R2-A (red line 1).** A disabled package is no holder for what serves or dispatches; a durable read counts every holder. The readers and their reading are listed under "Two slices" below.
- **R2-B.** `origin/main` merged (no rebase). #32548's boot-pass pins iterate `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY ∩ PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`; a webhook CONTROL pins that the boot pass registers and writes no webhook row. How a stored package-scoped webhook row loads at boot is measured and pinned for one and two holders. `webhook` is not added to the type registry.
- **R2-C (red line 3).** Every name whose `declared:NAME` fitted still delivers: `ref_id`'s cap is widened, the `dedup_key` cap was measured to bind first, and a key past it is digested.
- **R2-D.** The upgrade impact report reads webhooks by `(package, name)`; the remedies name the namespace address; row (1) names `/published`, pinned.

Round 3, comment [6820856607](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32577#issuecomment-6820856607) (after CR 6820826396 and red-line 6820837378):

- **R3-A (M1, blocking).** A redelivery reference that names no package counts `holdersOf(name)`, a disabled package's included; with two or more holders it is refused naming each. Commit `6b72041b`.
- **R3-B (text).** M2: the changeset's disabled co-holder bullet and the reader table below say what the protocol's by-name read answers (409 naming both, the disabled one included; a lone disabled holder 404; #32694); after the merge of #32497 that read judges the served set, and both say so (`17cec0fd0`). M3: the changeset's package-less row sentence says what boot does and names #32692. M5: the `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` docblock and Q3 below say main answers 200 with the first registered declaration. S3: the un-migrated database condition is a plain FROM → TO. Q4: `webhooks.mdx` §4.3. Commit `77becda1`.
- **R3-C (optional, done).** M4's two pins (the every-holder-disabled branch of the listed path; the bulk-event digest) and S2's pin (the report's `covered` by `(package, name)`). Commits `6b72041b`, `48b4cba4`.
- **R3-D (follow-up cards).** #32692 (Q1 ruled B: the boot hydration's artifact lookup by `(package, name)`; blocks #31699's close-out, lands before PR 3), #32694 (the protocol's generic by-name read counts a disabled holder, every package-scoped type but `action`; nested under #32354), #32695 (S1 and S4).

## Two slices (R2-A, corrected by R3)

| Reader | Reads | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `slotsOf` slots, `list()` (the dispatcher) | served | a disabled package's webhooks are not dispatched (#25308's listing) |
| `declaredWebhookNamed` (the reader's bare resolver: the bare activation door, the name guard) | served | the bare name answers the enabled holder alone |
| `declaredWebhookAt` (the redelivery veto of a `declared:PKG/NAME` delivery) | served | a delivery of a disabled package is refused, naming the package |
| `bindDeclaredWebhookNameGuard` | served | the conflict names the served holders' addresses |
| the qualified door's slots, the bare door's entry | served | an all-disabled namespace answers `404` |
| the redelivery veto of a `declared:NAME` delivery (`judgeDeclared`, the reader's `holdersOf`) | every holder | a delivery row is durable: two or more holders are refused naming each, whichever is disabled (R3-A) |
| `webhookSlotSwitch` (ledger row ownership), `reportUnownedRows` | every holder | a row naming no package under two holders stays no holder's own while one is disabled |
| the door's `adoptPackageless` (the reader's new `holdersOf`) | every holder | a write for the enabled holder never takes over that row |
| the boot backfill (`backfillActivationLedgerAtBoot`) | every holder | already read the raw registry; unchanged |
| not this PR's reader: the protocol's by-name item read, `GET /meta/webhook/NAME`, `/published`, `MetadataFacade.get` | served (#32497, merged in `281722eb4`) | under one enabled and one disabled holder it answers the enabled holder's declaration, `/published` as for that holder alone; a lone disabled holder answers `404` (the facade `undefined`). Before the merge it counted every holder (`409` naming both), #32694's premise for the webhook |

After the merge of #32497, `SchemaRegistry.packageScopedHoldersOf` answers the served holders unless asked otherwise, so the plugin's every-holder reading asks for every holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`, `91acdcc3f`); on the merged tree before that commit, 8 pins were red ("[FROM delivered TO withheld]", "[FROM A's switch TO no holder's]" and "[FROM allowed TO refused]", each in both orders; CONTROL one holder disabled; every holder disabled).
